sql.if: AND (L.LAW_FIRM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR L.LAWYER_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR S.CASE_NO LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR S.CASE_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')

mapper.sql: SL.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId, SL.SUIT_ID AS suitId, SL.LAWYER_ID AS lawyerId, SL.ASSIGN_DT AS assignDt, SL.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, L.LAW_FIRM AS lawFirm, L.LAWYER_NM AS lawyerNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm, NVL(S.RSLT_KIND_NM, RS.CODE_NM) AS rsltDispNm, SA.AVG_SCORE AS satisAvg, NVL(SA.CNT, 0) AS satisCnt

FROM LAW_SUIT_LAWYER SL JOIN LAW_LAWYER L ON L.LAWYER_ID = SL.LAWYER_ID JOIN LAW_SUIT S ON S.SUIT_ID = SL.SUIT_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE RS ON RS.CODE_ID = 'LAW_RESULT' AND RS.CODE = S.RSLT_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ASSIGN_ID, ROUND(AVG(SCORE), 1) AVG_SCORE, COUNT(*) CNT FROM LAW_LAWYER_SATIS GROUP BY ASSIGN_ID ) SA ON SA.ASSIGN_ID = SL.ASSIGN_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT_LAWYER SL JOIN LAW_LAWYER L ON L.LAWYER_ID = SL.LAWYER_ID JOIN LAW_SUIT S ON S.SUIT_ID = SL.SUIT_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT SL.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId, SL.SUIT_ID AS suitId, SL.LAWYER_ID AS lawyerId, SL.ASSIGN_DT AS assignDt, SL.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, L.LAW_FIRM AS lawFirm, L.LAWYER_NM AS lawyerNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm FROM LAW_SUIT_LAWYER SL JOIN LAW_LAWYER L ON L.LAWYER_ID = SL.LAWYER_ID JOIN LAW_SUIT S ON S.SUIT_ID = SL.SUIT_ID WHERE SL.ASSIGN_ID = #{assignId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_SUIT_LAWYER SET LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}, ASSIGN_DT = #{assignDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId, jdbcType=CHAR}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE ASSIGN_ID = #{assignId}
mapper.select: SELECT SA.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId, SA.EMPLYR_ID AS emplyrId, SA.SCORE AS score, SA.OPINION AS opinion, SA.REG_DT AS regDt, SA.UPD_DT AS updDt, E.USER_NM AS evaluatorNm FROM LAW_LAWYER_SATIS SA LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO E ON E.EMPLYR_ID = SA.EMPLYR_ID WHERE SA.ASSIGN_ID = #{assignId} ORDER BY NVL(SA.UPD_DT, SA.REG_DT) DESC
SELECT ASSIGN_ID AS assignId, EMPLYR_ID AS emplyrId, SCORE AS score, OPINION AS opinion FROM LAW_LAWYER_SATIS WHERE ASSIGN_ID = #{assignId} AND EMPLYR_ID = #{emplyrId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO LAW_LAWYER_SATIS T USING (SELECT #{assignId} ASSIGN_ID, #{emplyrId} EMPLYR_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.ASSIGN_ID = S.ASSIGN_ID AND T.EMPLYR_ID = S.EMPLYR_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SCORE = #{score}, T.OPINION = #{opinion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.UPD_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ASSIGN_ID, EMPLYR_ID, SCORE, OPINION, REG_DT) VALUES (#{assignId}, #{emplyrId}, #{score}, #{opinion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))
